thread:
emily.design: quick checkin on drilldown export UX. two connected asks: 1) final microcopy for export dropdown (users are confused whether export includes PII/redaction). 2) keyboard / SR behavior for stackframe links and correlation pill inside compact view.

raj.prod: +1. Also need to decide formats we show: JSON only vs JSON + HAR vs CSV for spans. product leaning JSON + optional HAR for request payloads.

sofia.research: user testing note: ops folks expect a clear filename that includes trace id + timestamp. suggestion: `redwood-trace-<trace-id>-20240612.json` rather than generic `trace.json`. users said generic names cause confusion when saving multiple exports.

lina.a11y: accessibility: the export menu should expose an aria-describedby that explains what fields are included and whether PII was redacted. Example: `aria-describedby="export-desc"` where `#export-desc` reads: "Includes spans, timestamps, and events. Sensitive fields redacted by default." Keep that visible text too.

matt.eng: implementation detail: we stream JSON; adding HAR export requires a transformation step (map spans -> HAR entries) which is doable but nontrivial. filename pattern is easy. redaction flag will be a server-side filter we can toggle.

emily.design: microcopy options I'm sketching: A) "Download trace (JSON)" + helper: "Filename includes trace id; sensitive fields redacted by default." B) "Export trace" + helper detail menu listing formats. C) two-step: quick download (JSON) + advanced export modal for HAR/csv & PII options. Thoughts?

lina.a11y: prefer explicit verbs: "Download trace (JSON)" is clearer for screen reader users. If we do advanced modal, ensure it traps focus and the primary action reads as `aria-label="Export trace with PII removed"` when PII toggled.

raj.prod: I like the two-step approach C. Quick default is JSON download with clear filename and note about redaction. Advanced modal for other formats + a checkbox: "Include sensitive fields (opt-in)" with consent wording. Legal ok with opt-in.

sofia.research: add small inline confirmation toast after download: "Trace saved as redwood-trace-9f3b...json". That helps users find file. For accessibility add aria-live polite on the toast.

export-bot: note: export telemetry tracked as `export_type`, `format`, `redaction_opt_in` in analytics.

matt.eng: keyboard focus: current tab sequence puts actions before the correlation pill in compact view. We should change DOM order: pill -> timeline -> actions so tab order matches reading order. For timeline (svg) add `tabindex="0"` and visible focus ring. For stackframes, links must include context: e.g., `View fnName (file:line)` instead of just `fnName`.

lina.a11y: make sure stackframe links also have `aria-labelledby` that references a hidden short description for screen readers: "Opens source context in side panel". And test with VoiceOver.

emily.design: decision summary: - quick button: "Download trace (JSON)" with helper line: "Filename includes trace id; sensitive fields redacted by default." - advanced export modal for HAR/CSV + opt-in PII toggle - toast on completion with aria-live polite - DOM reorder so correlation pill precedes actions, timeline gets tabindex=0 + visible focus style - stackframe links include file:line and aria description.

matt.eng: filing JIRA now with acceptance criteria + code pointers. will include backend flag for redaction and filename template.

emily.design: thanks — i'll update comps and copy tokens. will ping for final a11y pass before release. :raised_hands:
